comments.content: [medium] The new `text_size` member is never given a value when the label is created, so reading it before `lv_label_refr_text` populates it would be undefined behavior. It should be initialized to `{0, 0}` at creation time.

[low] Consider documenting the invariant for this cached value next to its declaration, for example which width constraint it was computed under, so future readers know when it is safe to reuse without recomputing.
[low] It may be worth checking how this path behaves for empty or whitespace-only text, since a zero-sized result could interact oddly with cached dimensions and downstream layout decisions.
